title: English Practice Quiz 0505
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.

questions.question: The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.
